scenarios.detail: Wide spread (250 pts > 80 pts) blocked new GOLD entry cleanly.
Flipped BUY -> SELL with zero simultaneous opposing positions.
3 consecutive losses activated cooldown (Loss-streak cooldown active (3 consecutive losses, 300s remaining)) and lot size did not escalate (0.2 -> 0.19).
Failed basket cleaned up state and re-primed without ghost positions.
Disconnected state blocked new entries and emitted alert.
Reconciled 2 existing scalper positions after terminal restart.
Adopted existing basket on Python restart without opening duplicate orders.
Duplicate tick/order guard blocked 1 duplicate evaluation(s).
Closed individual profitable position #901 while keeping remaining position #902 managed.
Blocked order when required margin exceeded free margin (Insufficient free margin: Required $10.00 > Free $5.00).
Normalized invalid volume to min_lot=0.01 and rejected under-budget trade (MIN_LOT_EXCEEDS_PERMITTED_RISK: Min lot 0.01 risks $3.37 > remaining risk budget $0.01).
Blocked entry gracefully when symbol spec is unavailable (Symbol specification for GOLD is unavailable.).
Blocked entry when broker session switched trade_mode to closed (0).
When BTCUSD is closed on weekend, engine waits and never substitutes GOLD.
Friday GOLD basket managed to completion on Saturday while new Saturday basket opened on BTCUSD.
Weekend BTCUSD basket managed to completion on Monday while new Monday basket opened on GOLD.
